Recordings stay inside Face Chaos. Open My recordings to replay, share or delete them. Tap Save to Gallery to copy a video to Movies / Face Chaos. Local originals are removed if the app is uninstalled; Gallery copies remain. Videos are currently silent and nothing is uploaded automatically.
Relax for face calibration. Stay quiet briefly for microphone calibration. Return to neutral between expressions. No shouting is needed. Videos are currently silent.
Try the next challenge - follow the cue
Say the country name in English

Match each gate: open mouth, closed-lip smile, show teeth, eyes wide open or face squeeze. For wide eyes, open both eyes with a relaxed mouth. For face squeeze, gently scrunch both eyes shut with your cheeks or nose briefly; a normal blink does not count. Relax between expressions. Each correct gate earns a coin.
Follow each obstacle cue. A short sound jumps; stronger volume jumps higher. Smile with closed lips to shield. Show teeth to attack. Act in the gold window and relax afterwards.
Smile to plant a seed, then blink once to bloom. Grow six flowers. Return to a relaxed face between actions.
Hum gently to rise; stay quiet to drift down. Guide the character through approaching gaps in five worlds. Each cleared obstacle earns a coin. Never shout.

Cross a scrolling course of fire gaps, steps, towers and moving ledges. Make a short sound in the gold window. More volume gives a higher jump, but low ceilings punish too much power. Failed jumps fall into fire and cost a life. Five difficulty levels increase gradually; no shouting is needed.
Smile with closed lips to make a spark, then hum gently to light a star. Complete three pairs. Relax between expressions and go quiet between sounds.
Open your mouth when a strawberry reaches the catch window. Keep your mouth closed for peppers. Each caught treat earns a coin; a pepper costs a life.
Wait until the moving block reaches the gold centre line, then smile with closed lips to drop it. Relax before the next block. Successful landings earn coins; off-centre blocks cost a life.
Hum gently to charge. Go quiet while the meter is in gold to launch. Watch the rocket land. Too little power falls short; too much goes past. Sound only: nothing to hold on screen.

Listen to the animal example, then copy its short and long sound rhythm with pauses. This checks rhythm, not the animal species. Twelve animals appear across the stages. The example pauses the round and microphone.

Watch the full expression sequence, then repeat it in order. Open mouth, closed-lip smile and teeth are distinct actions. Relax between each face. With face controls off, use the illustrated answer cards.
Hum gently in the gold sound range to guide the firefly to lanterns. Quiet makes it drift back. Each lit lantern earns a coin. Sound only: screen touches do not control flight.
Your sound volume controls the car accelerator. Soft sound is slower; a stronger comfortable sound is faster. Quiet lets the car coast. Beat the computer to the finish. No shouting is needed.

Centre your head to calibrate, then move left or right toward the clear lane. Return to centre for the middle lane. Dodge oncoming traffic. Tracking loss pauses the cars; faster stages bring harder traffic.

Look at each flag and say or type the country name in English. A correct answer earns a coin and shows the next flag. Speech recognition is still English in every interface language; typed answers are also available.
